build_PSPHead: build a PSPHead module for pyramid scene parsing network with configurable pool scales
create_PPM: create a Pooling Pyramid Module with adaptive average pooling and convolution for multi-scale feature extraction
run_PSPHead_forward: run the PSPHead forward pass on multi-level image features to produce segmentation output
run_PPM_forward: run the PPM forward pass to generate upsampled multi-scale pooled feature maps
review_PSPHead_forward_feature: review the PSPHead _forward_feature method that concatenates PPM outputs and applies bottleneck convolution
